new_general_arguments: PGL2 over a characteristic0 function field has no Q8 subgroup:central involution forces torus normalizer and only cyclic/ordinary-dihedral finite subgroups.
Birational automorphisms of an elliptic ruled surface preserve its genus1 base,whose automorphism group is metabelian. Hence a finite second-derived Q8 subgroup is impossible.
For a primitive elliptic ruled pencil,a reparameterization stabilizer preserves the primitive field. A trivial Mobius deck group of j forces it to fix the primitive parameter.
The normalizer circuit has primitive generic field C(t)(E_t)(x),E_t:k2=t-(1-b2)^2,j=64(4-3t)^3/(t2(1-t));unique pole and zero multiplicities force every j deck map trivial.

All primitive invariant phases on both exceptional models,all primitive factors on2I,and trivial-base-action primitive factors on2O exclude the elliptic ruled type. The2O nontrivial-base case requires an involutive j symmetry.

The original Hopf circuit is instead a birational coordinate. An averaged rational additive slice yields invariantization for every finite right subgroup,but cannot be regularized by any rational unary function.
For any C-domain with LND D and normalized h annihilating D(A),a rational slice Ds1 satisfies A intersection C(s)=C by local nilpotence and the forbidden constant in D(A).
exact_controls: Bidirectional elliptic and rational fibre coordinate identities,full determinant1 chart,quartic polynomial discriminant and Weierstrass j,its pole/zero divisors,derived-series and Q8 element orders,and the generic translated rational slice identity.
runtime: Python with Sympy1.14.0;exact rational symbolic calculations;finite exact cyclotomic group arithmetic;no support or degree sweep
logical_boundaries: The birational-group obstruction and LND slice lemma are written proofs;the checker certifies algebraic identities and finite groups,not all universal geometry.
A Mobius deck symmetry of the elliptic j-function is necessary for moving the primitive base;triviality rules out every rational reparameterization,not only powers.
The normalizer exclusion holds even for rational invariantization under arbitrary birational changes;the Hopf rational-fibre control shows it cannot be generalized to every known bad phase.
The invariant Hopf slice is not regular,and no unary rational expression regularizes it. Birational field isomorphisms do not supply regular Haar-period transfer.
Multivariable orbit averages,norms and regularizations outside these primitive-pencil classes remain open construction routes.
No all-degree exceptional MZ decision or full pure-null classification is claimed.
